hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Every node can act as a central connection hub for pairs of servers located in distinct branches.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: For each neighbor of the hub, count how many nodes in that subtree have path distance from the hub divisible by signalSpeed.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Multiply branch counts to tally cross-branch server pairs for each candidate hub.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: DFS traversal initiated from each node n.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: All-pairs shortest path without subtree branching takes O(n^3).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that valid pairs must lie in disjoint branches relative to the hub node.
